title: Genus zero smooth proper curves over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and $C$ a smooth proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves]. If $g(C)=\dim_kH^1(C,\mathcal O_C)=0$ [def-sc-genus], then $C$ is isomorphic over $k$ to the projective line $\mathbf P^1_k=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};\operatorname{Spec}k)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change].

source.place: Tag 0C6U (proposition-projective-line), characterization by genus zero and a degree-one point, specialized to an algebraically closed field.
